recognize_zh: 畫面擠滿白血球，涵蓋骨髓細胞、後骨髓細胞、帶狀及分葉核中性球等完整成熟階段，並有嗜鹼性球與嗜酸性球，母細胞稀少，是慢性期 CML 周邊血「縮小版骨髓」的樣貌。
features: Marked leukocytosis with densely packed granulocytic cells
Full spectrum of granulocytic maturation, with myelocytes and segmented/band neutrophils predominating
Basophils with coarse dark purple granules and eosinophils with orange granules
Occasional promyelocytes and rare blast-like cells; blasts not increased
Occasional small lymphocyte/nucleated cell; platelets scattered
describe_en: The smear shows a marked leukocytosis composed of granulocytes at all stages of maturation, with a myelocyte and mature neutrophil predominance. Basophils and eosinophils are readily identified. Promyelocytes and rare blast-like cells are present, but blasts are not increased. Neutrophils lack prominent toxic granulation or dysplasia. Given the very high cellularity, the preparation may be a thick peripheral blood area or buffy coat; the findings are consistent with chronic myeloid leukemia, chronic phase.

ddx.vs: Leukemoid reactions show toxic granulation and Döhle bodies, a mature neutrophil predominance without a myelocyte bulge, no basophilia, and are BCR::ABL1-negative.
aCML shows dysplastic hypogranular or pseudo-Pelger neutrophils, lacks basophilia and is BCR::ABL1-negative.
CMML shows absolute monocytosis (>=0.5 x 10^9/L and >=10% of WBC) with fewer circulating immature granulocytes.
Advanced disease shows increased blasts or basophils >=20%, which are not evident in this field.
